title: Ex-Co bodyguards' lawyer Levi Baligod arrested
summary: Lawyer Levito Baligod, counsel of the former bodyguards of fugitive ex-Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co, was arrested Friday in relation to the unjust vexation complaint filed against him.
